title: What the Celebrity Club looked like
summary: Upstairs and downstairs, Polynesian-style decor, intimate dance room.

blocks.x: Yeah. How big was the Celebrity Club? Is it still there?
It's still there. I haven't been in it since. I just haven't been down there, you know. I understand it's so different now until I just don't want to see it like that.
Not too big, but he had upstairs and downstairs, see, and I got Milton Larkin upstairs and he worked there 11. He had the band upstairs. And --
